# Hook events agy accepts in a plugin hooks.json, and the entry structure each one
# requires. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — consumed by tests/structure/test-hooks-json-shape.sh
# and the promptfoo host-contract catalog. Keep it in lockstep with the host's own
# specification and with what a live install actually accepts.
#
# Source: ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/skills/agy-customizations/docs/hooks.md
#         ("Supported Event Types" table), agy 1.1.10.
#
# Format: <EventName> <structure>
#   grouped -> array of {matcher, hooks:[handler,...]} wrappers; matcher is a tool-name regex
#   flat    -> array of handler objects directly; a matcher is ignored by the host
#
# Why this matters: shipping a grouped entry for a flat event does NOT warn at
# install time and does NOT show up in `agy plugin validate`. The host logs
#   hooks.go:66 Failed to parse hooks for plugin <name>: invalid hook "<group>":
#   command hook must specify 'command'
# to its own CLI log and then runs WITHOUT that hook group. zensu shipped exactly
# that defect for PreInvocation and Stop, so the intent router, the TDD reminder
# and the Stop chain-enforcer were silently inert on every run.

PreToolUse grouped
PostToolUse grouped
PreInvocation flat
PostInvocation flat
Stop flat
